q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an aluminium ladder?
title: Aluminium ladder carbon footprint per ladder
short: Weigh the aluminium sections per ladder and multiply by the extruder's per-kg figure. Add rivets, feet and hinges, then cutting, punching and riveting energy, divided by ladders made. Report by height.

p: Report per ladder by height and type. Aluminium is almost all of the material, so the billet source matters.

example.title: Worked example: aluminium ladder unit per ladder (one month)
lines: Plant total: 2,840 / 4,000 = 0.710 kg CO2 per ladder
Add aluminium sections and fittings for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
